proxy.upgradePolicy: Immutable runtime allowlist: delivered V1/V2 only, same constructor manager

swapRouter.launchRequirement: Deploy and integrate this input-prepaying router before opening trading whenever prior IMD backing is insufficient, including paper-only liquidity. Settle-after routers depend on the shared manager's changing IMD balance; historical backing does not guarantee availability. Same-swap payouts remain mandatory; there is no deferred claim fallback.

oracle.emptyLiquidityPrice: Launch sqrtPriceX96, replaced by the latest post-swap price with active liquidity

posting.legacyRisk: No caller price cap; migrate integrations even if their burn allowance is unlimited. A manipulated quote can persist after the attacker removes dust liquidity because the empty-liquidity fallback retains the last active price.

status: Review parameters only; launch blocked until the manifest/deployer supports the initialized proxy and admission explicitly permits DELEGATECALL. No deployment or broadcast performed.
